ImageDescription.value: Albanian Alps seen from the air looking East. In the center the valley and the village of Theth. In the upper part on the right the Valbona valley with Maja Roshit and Kollata to the left. Between the two valleys are the Valbona pass (Qafa e Valbonës) and the Jezerca massif with the Jezerca peak between two clouds. To the left is the Peja pass (Qafa e Pejës) and the pyramid of Maja Arapit. Behind in the upper left corner the Montenegrinian Ropojana valley and the valley of Plav with parts of Lake Plav. To the left is the Radohima massif. In the lower part can be seen the road to Theth over Terthorja pass (Qafa Terthorjës).
